identity_binding.notes: gate-results.git_sha/source_sha must equal worktree HEAD. local-process:// is honest non-landing theatre. Prefer independently identified deployed HTTP service for landing claims.

notes: REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03: every step invokes a real cutover CLI verb via bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts, then asserts a conjunctive multi-field jq oracle (require-all, never any-of).
Step 1 coordinates with REDHAT-FIX-S29-C01: cutover:go-no-go + overall.ok + failed_count==0 + 8 gates (never length-only).
D06-07 steps 2-4 deploy the exact release, prove SIGKILL durability, reject invalid identities, and perform MCP initialize/tools/list only against one HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL.
Step 5 combines freeze plus quiet-check and requires every fence/drain field conjunctively.
Step 6 run-etl (CAP-MIG-01) requires ok + unexplainedVariance==0 + stages.nonEmpty + source non-empty + fkAudit.ok + vectors.ok.
Step 7 flip + verify-soak derives from the verified deployment URL and requires concrete tools/jobs/article/hono/reads results.
Step 8 probes the already-listening deployed Hono surface and asserts HTTP 423 + migration_read_only without an in-process listener.

Historical false-pass lineage preserved under .gate-evidence/20260802T004525Z/ (do not rewrite). Oracle suite: PLATFORM_IT=1 pnpm vitest run --project integration services/platform/tests/integration/sprint29-human-gate-oracles.test.ts

REDHAT-FIX-S29-R2-H01: re-run via scripts/run-sprint29-human-gate-rerun.sh; freshness suite services/platform/tests/integration/sprint29-human-gate-freshness.test.ts refuses run_id 20260802T004525Z as current pass. Honest fail/partial is required.

steps.text: Run full harness suite against new stack (cutover:go-no-go) — overall.ok and failed_count==0
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/D06-02 .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts cutover:go-no-go --json --output go-no-go-report.json | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03/step1-go-no-go.json; jq -e '.overall.ok == true and .failed_count == 0 and (.gates | length) == 8 and all(.gates[] | select(.collectedTests != null); .collectedTests > 0)' go-no-go-report.json

assertion.notes: REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03 + C01 coordination: real cutover:go-no-go CLI; never gates|length==8 alone; failed_count must be 0.

steps.text: Deploy exact pinned four-service release on inference1 (deploy:apply)
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; : "${HOLO_RELEASE_PATH:?HOLO_RELEASE_PATH is required}"; : "${HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL:?HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL is required}"; mkdir -p .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-DEPLOY; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts --help >/dev/null; bash scripts/deploy-inference1.sh --authorize --release "$HOLO_RELEASE_PATH" --base-url "$HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL" | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-DEPLOY/step2-deploy.json; jq -e --slurpfile lock "$HOLO_RELEASE_PATH" '.authorized == true and .host == "inference1" and .runtime == "container" and (.services == ["postgres","mastra","scheduler","zero-cache"]) and .image == $lock[0].image and .imageDigest == $lock[0].digest and .sourceRevision == $lock[0].sourceRevision and .composeSha256 == $lock[0].composeSha256 and .cutoverActions == 0 and .volumeDeletions == 0 and .baseUrl == env.HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-DEPLOY/deployment-record.json

assertion.notes: D06-07: explicit authorization, exact four services, no cutover action or volume deletion.

steps.text: Prove strict readiness, Postgres 503, SIGKILL restart, durability, and MCP registration
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; : "${HOLO_RELEASE_PATH:?HOLO_RELEASE_PATH is required}"; : "${HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL:?HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL is required}"; export HOLO_VERIFY_BASE_URL="$HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL"; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts deploy:verify --release "$HOLO_RELEASE_PATH" --base-url "$HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL" --restart-probe --json | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-DEPLOY/step3-verify-restart.json; jq -e '.ok == true and .baseUrl == env.HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL and .dependency.status == 503 and .dependency.failingDependency == "postgres" and .restart.signal == "SIGKILL" and (.restart.newPid != .restart.oldPid) and .restart.postgresRows == 1 and .restart.blobObjects == 1 and .mcp.initialize == true and .mcp.toolsListCount == 44 and .mcp.toolInvocations == 0' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-DEPLOY/step3-verify-restart.json

assertion.notes: D06-07: docker kill SIGKILL, not compose stop, proves restart policy and both durable sentinels.

steps.text: Reject invalid deployment identities and hand off one verified base URL
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; : "${HOLO_RELEASE_PATH:?HOLO_RELEASE_PATH is required}"; : "${HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL:?HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL is required}"; export HOLO_VERIFY_BASE_URL="$HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL"; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts deploy:verify --release "$HOLO_RELEASE_PATH" --base-url "$HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL" --negative-controls --mcp-discovery --json | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-DEPLOY/step4-identity.json; jq -e '.ok == true and .baseUrl == env.HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL and .identityClass == "deployed-http" and .handoffVerified == true and (.identityNegatives.rejected == ["loopback","in-process","stale","mismatched","missing","verifier-supplied"]) and .identityNegatives.landingEligible == false and .mcp.toolsListCount == 44 and .toolInvocations == 0 and .soakInvocations == 0' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-DEPLOY/step4-identity.json

assertion.notes: D06-07: observed health identity only; initialize/tools-list registration proof, never tools/call or soak.

steps.text: Arm durable write fence and drain quiet interval (cutover:freeze + cutover:quiet-check)
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/D06-03 .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts cutover:freeze --json --output .tmp/D06-03/freeze-report.json --reason "sprint-29-human-gate" | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03/step5-freeze.json; jq -e '.ok == true and .env_value == "1" and .fence_armed_at > 0' .tmp/D06-03/freeze-report.json; QUIET_WINDOW_SECONDS="${QUIET_WINDOW_SECONDS:-30}"; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts cutover:quiet-check --json --window-seconds "$QUIET_WINDOW_SECONDS" --output .tmp/D06-03/quiet-check-report.json | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03/step5-quiet-check.json; jq -e --argjson minWindow "$QUIET_WINDOW_SECONDS" '.ok == true and .acceptedWriteCount == 0 and .rejectedWriteCount > 0 and .windowSeconds >= $minWindow' .tmp/D06-03/quiet-check-report.json

set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/D06-04 .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts cutover:run-etl --json --output .tmp/D06-04/watermark-report.json | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03/step6-run-etl.json; jq -e '.ok == true and .unexplainedVariance == 0 and .stages.nonEmpty == true and ((.loadedByTable.documents // 0) > 0 or ((.archive.exportData.rowCounts.documents // 0) > 0)) and (.fkAudit.ok == true) and (.vectors.ok == true)' .tmp/D06-04/watermark-report.json

steps.text: Flip app+MCP and verify read-only soak through the verified deployment URL
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; : "${HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL:?HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL is required}"; export HOLO_VERIFY_BASE_URL="$HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL"; mkdir -p .tmp/D06-05 .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts cutover:flip --json --etl-report .tmp/D06-04/watermark-report.json --output .tmp/D06-05/flip-report.json | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03/step7-flip.json; jq -e '.ok == true and .env_value == "1"' .tmp/D06-05/flip-report.json; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts cutover:verify-soak --json --base-url "$HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL" --etl-report .tmp/D06-04/watermark-report.json --output .tmp/D06-05/verify-soak-report.json | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03/step7-verify-soak.json; jq -e --arg base "$HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL" '(.overall.ok == true) and (.base_url == $base) and ((.tools.toolsPassed // .toolsPassed) | type == "number") and ((.tools.toolsTotal // .toolsTotal) | type == "number") and ((.tools.toolsTotal // .toolsTotal) > 0) and ((.tools.toolsPassed // .toolsPassed) == (.tools.toolsTotal // .toolsTotal)) and ((.jobsAccounted // .jobs.jobsAccounted) == (.jobsTotal // .jobs.jobsTotal)) and (.article.ok == true) and (.honoWrite.ok == true) and (.reads.ok == true)' .tmp/D06-05/verify-soak-report.json

steps.text: Write returns migration_read_only (HTTP 423) on the deployed Hono surface
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; : "${HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL:?HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL is required}"; mkdir -p .tmp/D06-05 .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03; test -f .tmp/D06-05/flip-report.json; jq -e '.ok == true and .env_value == "1"' .tmp/D06-05/flip-report.json >/dev/null; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts --help 2>&1 | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03/step8-dispatcher-help.txt | rg -q 'cutover:(flip|verify-soak)'; HOLO_RN_KEY="$(bun -e 'import { getSecretValue, resolveSecretsPathFromEnv } from "./services/platform/src/config/secrets.ts"; const v=getSecretValue("HOLO_KEY_RN",{secretsPath:resolveSecretsPathFromEnv()}); if(!v) process.exit(2); process.stdout.write(v)')"; HTTP_STATUS="$(curl -sS -o .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03/step8-write-body.json -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$HOLO_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL/api/documents" -H "Authorization: Bearer $HOLO_RN_KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"title":"sprint29-gate","content":"write-must-be-rejected"}')"; unset HOLO_RN_KEY; jq -n --argjson status "$HTTP_STATUS" --slurpfile body .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03/step8-write-body.json '{status:$status,body:$body[0]}' | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03/step8-write-probe.json; jq -e '.status == 423 and ((.body.error == "migration_read_only") or (.body.code == "migration_read_only"))' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-S29-H03/step8-write-probe.json

assertion.notes: D06-07: deployed HTTP probe; no createHonoApp/in-process identity and no secret emitted.
